core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hashim corresponds to the Arabic form هاشم (Arabic root ه ش م (h-sh-m); هَاشِم (Hāshim)). Its core sense is good, beautiful, virtuous, excellent. Hashim is Arabic هَاشِم (Hāshim), a well-documented male given name borne by Hashim ibn Abd Manaf, great-grandfather of the Prophet Muhammad, and the eponym of the Banu Hashim clan. The source gloss 'Bringer of Peace' is unsupported; the name is a proper name. Same root as hashimi.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Hashim, hashim. Script forms are هاشم, ہاشم, हाशिम.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
